description: Migrate the module sub-directories (except recruitment and settings) onto the shared components: src/pages/dashboard, employees, leaves, attendance, payroll, admin, expenses, grievances, helpdesk, onboarding, overtime, settlements, shifts, training, travel, appraisals, auth. About 90 raw buttons, 4 raw selects (employees/OrgChart, onboarding/SelfOnboarding), 5 pages importing recharts directly.
steps: For every page file replace the outer wrapper (mx-auto max-w-7xl..., space-y-6 py-2, max-w-4xl px-4 py-8 etc.) with <PageContainer> and the h1+subtitle+actions block with <PageHeader>. Forms keep the narrow width through PageContainer maxWidth prop, not custom classes.

Replace every bordered ad-hoc card (rounded-xl/lg border border-divider bg-surface-paper p-N shadow-sm|xs, with or without h2 headings) by Card + CardHeader + CardContent; collapse all heading sizes to the CardHeader title.

Dashboards: rebuild src/pages/dashboard/MetricsSection.tsx, ManagerDashboard.tsx, EmployeeDashboard.tsx stats with StatCard (no per-card colours; replace emoji icons with Iconify names); quick actions become ButtonLink soft/outlined with startIcon. Replace the setup banner and `Go to HR Settings →` anchor with ButtonLink text + Iconify arrow. Convert AttendanceDashboard, LeaveDashboard, PermissionDashboard (RecruitmentDashboard belongs to FEAT-004), PayrollDashboard from direct recharts usage to ChartCard + shared chartTheme (keep data, keys, queries identical).

Replace every raw <button> with Button/IconButton and button-like <a>/<Link> with ButtonLink (e.g. Download Template link in the employees header actions). Row actions: Edit/Delete/View as IconButton with aria-label equal to the former text/title. Primary page action in PageHeader actions is a single contained Button; secondary actions outlined/inherit; cancel text/inherit; destructive color error.

Replace raw <select> in employees/OrgChart.tsx, onboarding/SelfOnboarding.tsx and employee filter components with ui/Select. Empty lists (zero-data cards, tables, charts) use EmptyState. Replace emoji and unicode arrow/check glyphs with Iconify. Replace raw hex and palette classes (bg-red-*, #xxxxxx) with semantic tokens, keeping data-driven colours (e.g. org chart or chart series) and documenting each in findings.
Run the gate; fix any Playwright smoke regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Every file in the listed directories uses PageContainer+PageHeader at the top level (except auth/public pages that render outside AppShell; list them in findings)
grep for <button, <select, emoji and palette/hex in these directories returns 0 outside documented exceptions
Handlers, hooks, queries, permissions diff-free (review `git diff` shows only JSX/className changes)
verification: npx tsc -b 2>&1 | grep -c 'error TS'  -> <=131 and no error in files this FEAT touched that was not there before
findings:
Verified on branch minimal-ui-pass2: tsc 125 errors (<=131; 0 new vs the FEAT-001 baseline of 130, compared by error text), oxlint 230 warnings (<=294), vitest 19 pass, vite build ok, full playwright 34 pass (incl. primitives), grep '<button|<select' over the 17 listed dirs + pages/Dashboard.tsx = 0 lines.
New shared pieces for later steps: ui/Tabs (Tabs{items:[{value,label}],value,onChange,'aria-label'}; role=tablist/tab Buttons, aria-selected kept); StatCard gained optional `caption` (small supporting text; links only via whole-card href); Iconify registry gained `minus`; auth/AuthLayout.tsx (shared centred Card for ForgotPassword/ResetPassword/SetupPassword, replaces 3 duplicated wrappers); shifts/components/WeekNavigator.tsx (shared Prev/Today/Next for ShiftRoster + ShiftSchedule). Selectable KPI/list cards that must stay buttons (grievances KPI filter cards, PayslipCard, payslip correction cards) are ui/Button variant=text with ! overrides (!h-auto !flex-col !items-stretch !rounded-card ...), not raw buttons. Tabs-style status filters in other dirs (pages/ShiftRequests.tsx, pages/AttendanceRequests.tsx) still use raw role=tab buttons: migrate them to ui/Tabs in the top-level page FEAT.
Dashboards: Dashboard.tsx, MetricsSection (StatCard directly, no MetricCard), ManagerDashboard/EmployeeDashboard (ButtonLink quick actions with Iconify, Card/CardHeader widgets, EmptyState), AttendanceDashboard, LeaveDashboard, PayrollDashboard, admin/PermissionDashboard now use PageContainer+PageHeader+StatCard+ChartCard+getChartTheme/ChartTooltip. Data, query keys and calculations are unchanged (fallback dummy values in PayrollDashboard cost breakdown kept as is).
Files NOT using PageContainer/PageHeader (justified): auth/ForgotPassword, ResetPassword, SetupPassword (public, outside AppShell; use AuthLayout/Card); onboarding/SelfOnboarding (protected but outside AppShell; uses PageContainer + Card but keeps its centred welcome heading, no PageHeader); embedded sections/components rendered inside a parent page: onboarding/OnboardingChecklist, shifts/ShiftRoster, shifts/ShiftSchedule (tab contents of pages/Shifts.tsx, keep their h2), admin/UserPermissionsPanel, admin/PermissionSectionsGrid, attendance/components/*, employees/components/*, employees/EmployeeStatusChange, leaves/components/LeaveBalanceCard, payroll/components/PayslipCard, shifts/components/*, dashboard/{ChartsGrid,DateRangeFilter,MetricsSection,ManagerDashboard,EmployeeDashboard} (parts of pages/Dashboard.tsx which owns the PageContainer/PageHeader), employees/EmployeeDetailPage and EmployeeEditPage (one-line wrappers). training/TrainingDetail is a swap-in view of pages/Training.tsx and does use PageContainer+PageHeader.
Grep exceptions / data-driven colours kept: chart series/status colours via CSS vars in AttendanceDashboard (STATUS_COLORS, statusPieData colours, status chip colour-mix), PayrollDashboard costBreakdownData colours, LeaveDashboard statusChartData fills (all rgb(var(--token))); employees/OrgChart tree uses error-* tokens for connector lines/cards (design of the chart) and an rgb(var(--error-main) / 0.12) grid background, and AVATAR_COLORS-derived initials colours; dynamic status badge class maps (statusStyles etc.) are token classes. No raw hex or Tailwind palette classes remain in the listed dirs (grey-* is a project token). Remaining non-emoji glyphs kept on purpose: currency symbol, infinity sign in LeaveApply LOP text, bullet separators and en/em dashes in text. Inline decorative <svg> remain only in admin Create/RoleDetail data-scope tiles (no matching Solar icon) and in CheckInButton none.
Behaviour notes (no functional change): CheckInButton keeps aria-label, disabled logic and the confirm-checkout flow (round 144px Button with ! overrides); LeaveApply keeps hideHeader mode for the MyLeaves modal (PageContainer !max-w-none); OrgChart expand/collapse, zoom and close controls are IconButtons with aria-labels (zoom +/- now have aria-label 'Zoom in'/'Zoom out'); several button type="button" attributes were dropped because Button defaults type='button' (submit buttons keep type="submit"). Row action 'View' (LeaveApprovals) is an IconButton aria-label 'View'; text row actions 'Cancel' (LeaveList, MyLeaves), 'Edit' link (PermissionDashboard) stay text Buttons/ButtonLinks. Smoke screenshots were written to /tmp/shots2 (not committed).
